title: [perf]fix current stream (#11870)
gain_evidence: The forward time for every step (batchsize 8) reduces from 20.77ms to 20.45ms.

experiments.name: current_stream_lookup
experiments.workload: benchmark_latency.py on Meta-Llama-3-70B, --load-format dummy --enforce-eager -tp 4; avg end-to-end decode latency over the run.
experiments.note: diff replaces torch.cuda.current_stream() with vllm.utils.current_stream() in pynccl.py (all_reduce/all_gather/reduce_scatter/send/recv warmup paths), caching the stream to avoid the per-call CUDA stream query overhead. Numbers from PR body: main 2.945735s vs this PR 2.851607s avg latency.

reported.scope: full E2E avg decode latency of a 70B tp=4 serving run; the fixed op is a per-call CUDA stream lookup inside every NCCL collective, a tiny fraction of that latency.
reported.scale_short: Author's number is whole-run E2E latency (~3%); our isolated op is just the stream lookup. TO MAKE 1:1: microbench the current_stream() call path (cached vs torch.cuda.current_stream()) in isolation, or reproduce the full 70B tp=4 benchmark_latency run on 4 GPUs.
reported.scale_note: Requires 4 GPUs and NCCL; the 3% is diluted across the entire decode loop, so an isolated stream-lookup microbench will show a far larger ratio on the op itself but a negligible absolute delta. Direction (lower latency) is genuine.
